query.description: PromQL query text; runtime limit is 32768 UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII queries may contain fewer characters.

time.description: Absolute time as Unix seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (number or numeric string; fractional seconds allowed), or a timezone-qualified RFC3339 string, e.g. 2026-11-03T08:00:00+08:00. Numeric values are seconds, not milliseconds. Defaults to now.
